response.overview: Disc Twenty - Blu-ray (The video vaults).  This super deluxe box set comprises 13 albums released by Charisma and Virgin between 1971-1986.  Each album has been remastered from the original master tapes, along with new 5.1 and stereo remixes of “The Future Now” and “pH7” by Stephen W Tayler, rare BBC sessions and live recordings as well as a Blu-Ray video disc of previously unreleased European television performances. Coupled with the set comes a 12 inch, 76-page, hardbacked book containing rare images and new, extensive album commentary from Peter Hammill. A D2C offering which includes an exclusive postcard is also available.
response.title: Peter Hammill - The Video Vaults
